# AQUA Innovations

AQUA Innovations is a multidisciplinary brand activation, experience design, marketing, architecture and technology agency based in Dhaka, Bangladesh.

## Primary services
- Brand activation and live events
- Social media marketing
- Branding and identity systems
- Video production
- Content creation
- Sports marketing
- Website and workflow automation
- Architectural and spatial design
